name: RPLIDAR C1
description: Compact, cheap 360° DTOF LiDAR: 12 m range, 5 kHz at 10 Hz, ±30 mm, 40 klux sunlight tolerance, IP54, single 5 V supply. A strong modern replacement for the A1 on small ROS robots.

variants.note: XH2.54-5P socket; only VCC, TX, RX, GND are used. Kits include a CP2102 USB adapter and cable

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: DTOF, 905 nm, IEC-60825 Class 1. Outputs reflectivity alongside distance.
Black (10%) target: 0.05–6 m. White (70%) target: 0.05–12 m.
UART 460800 baud 8N1, 3.3 V TTL. USB only through the bundled CP2102 adapter.
One 4.8–5.2 V rail for core and motor: 230 mA typ (260 max) at 10 Hz, 800 mA at start-up; ripple ≤150 mV.
No motor-control pin. Speed (8–12 Hz) is set by serial command, and the motor runs only while scanning.
Compatible with the S-series protocol and the A-series standard protocol; needs a current rplidar_sdk / rplidar_ros (ROS and ROS2).
